body:
Shipped: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/claude-plugin — plugin.json + marketplace.json (repo doubles as its own marketplace), `.mcp.json` bound to `${OBJECTSTACK_MCP_URL}`, the generic SKILL.md rendered verbatim from `@objectstack/mcp@13.0.0` (byte-identical, verified), `/objectstack:connect` guided command, weekly drift-guard CI against npm@latest (green). `claude plugin validate` passes clean.

Install: `claude plugin marketplace add objectstack-ai/claude-plugin` → `claude plugin install objectstack@objectstack`.

Bonus (same pattern): https://github.com/objectstack-ai/gemini-extension (#2714 Phase 2 item, also live with green drift-guard).
